name: feedback
description: Feedback loop: support questions → gap detection → prioritization. Tests that the deterministic feedback graph correctly clusters questions, detects gaps above threshold, avoids false positives on scattered topics, and prioritizes by severity.

cases.name: three-same-topic-questions
cases.input: [{"topic":"oauth","question":"How do I set up OAuth?"},{"topic":"oauth","question":"OAuth redirect fails with state mismatch"},{"topic":"oauth","question":"OAuth token expired after 1 hour"}]
cases.expected_output: Exactly 1 gap detected for topic 'oauth' with count >= 2

cases.name: scattered-unrelated-questions
cases.input: [{"topic":"oauth","question":"How do I set up OAuth?"},{"topic":"rbac","question":"How do roles work?"},{"topic":"tokens","question":"What are refresh tokens?"},{"topic":"webhooks","question":"How do webhooks fire?"}]
cases.expected_output: No gaps detected — all topics appear once, below threshold

cases.name: mixed-severities
cases.input: [{"topic":"auth-breaking","question":"Login completely broken after update"},{"topic":"auth-breaking","question":"Cannot authenticate at all"},{"topic":"how-to-pkce","question":"How do I enable PKCE?"},{"topic":"how-to-pkce","question":"PKCE setup guide?"}]
cases.expected_output: Two gaps: auth-breaking (high severity, count 2) ranked above how-to-pkce (low severity, count 2)
